title: I-Lang Research: the source of research.ilang.ai
description: The site of I-Lang Research, the research division of iLang Inc., Canada, published at research.ilang.ai. It collects the protocol papers, datasets, open-source records and archive pages behind the I-Lang protocol, among them the Judgment Calibration and Judgment Layer Audit datasets published with the site. Built with Hugo and the PaperMod theme and deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
